Package hu.bme.mit.theta.analysis.algorithm.mdd.node.expression

Class SymbolicValues

java.lang.Object
hu.bme.mit.theta.analysis.algorithm.mdd.node.expression.SymbolicValues
All Implemented Interfaces:
MddValues
public final class SymbolicValues extends Object implements MddValues
Symbolic values: a key is a literal or the token, which leaves the value of its variable to the terminal below, a formula over the current values of the token variables. A step conjoins what the relation leaves over and projects the overwritten values out; what cannot be eliminated is kept under a name bound in that formula. One instance belongs to the diagrams of one check.
